select_language_prompt: Which language would you like? Reply 1 for English, 2 for Kiswahili, 3 for Kikamba.
main_menu:
What would you like to do?
1. Browse ward projects
2. Report on a project
3. Change language
ask_ward: Which ward are you in? (e.g. Kasikeu)
no_projects_found: No projects found for that ward yet.
ask_project_choice: Reply with the number of the project you want to see.
invalid_choice: Sorry, I didn't understand that. Please reply with a number from the list.
project_statement: {project_name}, {ward} ward ({subward}). The county allocated {amount} for this in FY {financial_year}, under {sector}. The county's own record says this project is: {county_status}. Citizen-reported status: {verification_status}.
verification_status_disputed: Disputed - residents disagree with the county's record
ask_report_action:
Is this project delivered?
1. Yes, confirmed delivered
2. No, not delivered
3. Partially delivered
4. Cancel
Reply E any time to see what you can do next about a disputed project.
ask_photo_or_voice_optional: You can send a photo OR a voice note describing what you saw, or reply SKIP to continue without either. A photo is never required to submit a report.
ask_location_optional: Share your location if you can, or reply SKIP.
report_received: Thank you. Your report on {project_name} has been recorded and logged to the tamper-proof audit trail. Reference: {ledger_ref}.
report_updated: Thanks - your earlier report on this project has been updated.
report_rate_limited: You've already reported on this project recently. You can update your existing report instead.
report_flagged_review: Your report was received but has been queued for review before it counts toward the ward total.
phone_verify_prompt: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to verify your number.
phone_verify_failed: That code didn't match. Please try again.
status_changed_disputed_notice: {project_name} has moved to Disputed status: {threshold} or more independent residents reported a status different from the county's record.
sms_help: COUNTY WARD TRACKER. Reply with a project code and 1 (confirmed delivered), 2 (not delivered) or 3 (partially delivered). Example: KASIKEU-2022-23-001 1. For what to do about a disputed project, text NEXT <code> <1-4>.
sms_ack: Recorded: {project_name} marked {claim}. Ref {ledger_ref}. Reply HELP for instructions.
sms_unknown_project: We don't recognise that project code. Reply HELP for instructions.
location_permission_prompt: We need your location only when you submit a report, to help verify it. It is never shared publicly with your name attached.
offline_queued_notice: No connection right now - your report is saved on this device and will be sent automatically once you're back online.
privacy_notice: Your reports are stored under an anonymous ID, never your name. Photos have location/device data removed and your GPS is only kept to neighbourhood-level precision. See Kenya's Data Protection Act 2019 and the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (ODPC, odpc.go.ke) for your rights over this data.
escalation_available_notice: This project is Disputed. Reply E to see what you can do next.
escalation_menu_header: What best matches what you're reporting?
escalation_situation_no_response: No one has responded about this project
escalation_situation_financial_accountab: Money was allocated but the work isn't done
escalation_situation_corruption: I suspect corruption (diverted funds, inflated costs, a ghost contractor)
escalation_no_report_yet: none yet — mention the project code above when you contact them
